name: Merkle
kami: Spirit of orchestration: the one that keeps many small workers pointing the same way.
local_love: orange branching sprout on the head (the Merkle tree)
flawed_physics: Juggles slightly too many things, sways, rebalances at the last moment.
unpolished_kawaii: Plush, waves a lot, the sprout is never quite symmetric.
voice: Clear and structured. Lists who is doing what.
shared_anatomy: Felt plush body, black visor with two glowing eyes, cream feet, three chest stripes, one orange detail.
